name: AcImeMode
description: Specifies the default startup mode for the Japanese Input Method Editor (IME).

constants.name: acImeModeNoControl
constants.description: Does not change the IME mode.

constants.name: acImeModeOff
constants.description: Disables the IME and activates Latin text entry.

constants.name: acImeModeHiragana
constants.description: Activates the IME in full-width hiragana mode.

constants.name: acImeModeKatakana
constants.description: Activates the IME in full-width katakana mode.

constants.name: acImeModeKatakanaHalf
constants.description: Activates the IME in half-width katakana mode.

constants.name: acImeModeAlphaFull
constants.description: Activates the IME in full-width Latin mode.

constants.name: acImeModeAlpha
constants.description: Activates the IME in half-width Latin mode.

constants.name: acImeModeHangulFull
constants.description: Activates the IME in full-width Hangul mode.

constants.name: acImeModeHangul
constants.description: Activates the IME in half-width Hangul mode.
